definitions.gloss: new school term; new semester; new academic term
definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new academic term or semester. In Japan, the school year traditionally starts in April, so 新学期 most commonly refers to the start of the April term.

examples.japanese: {新学期|しんがっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The new school term has begun.

examples.japanese: {新学期|しんがっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}いそろえた。
examples.english: I bought all the textbooks in preparation for the new term.

examples.japanese: {新学期|しんがっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: When the new term starts, I look forward to making new friends.

notes:
USAGE:
{新学期|しんがっき} combines {新|しん} (new) and ⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧ (school term/semester). In Japan, the academic year begins in April, so {新学期|しんがっき} most often refers to the spring term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新学期|しんがっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (the new term begins)
- {新学期|しんがっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧ (in preparation for the new term)
- {新学期|しんがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ (preparation for the new term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧ is the general word for a school term or semester. ⟦{新年度|しんねんど}→新年度：15459_shinnendo⟧ refers to the new fiscal or academic year as a whole, which is broader than a single term.
